description: Samoca于1957年推出的旁轴相机。配备C. EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, f/3.5 50mm or D.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, f/2.8 50mm, depending on model.。快门速度Five-speed leaf shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.。使用35mm。

specs.镜头: C. EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, f/3.5 50mm or D.EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, f/2.8 50mm, depending on model.
specs.快门: Five-speed leaf shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.
specs.光圈: f/3.5 to f/22 for the f/3.5 lens; f/2.8 to f/16 for the f/2.8 lens
specs.英文简介: The Samoca 28 X and the 35 X are both rangefinder cameras for 35mm film with a built-in light meter, made in Japan by Sanei Sangyō K.K.
